components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action; saffron background with deep-night text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #0B0B0D; background: #f0c444; border: none; border-radius: 14px; transition: background 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e0b434; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(240, 196, 68, 0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis action; warm-paper background with border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #0B0B0D; background: #FDFBF7; border: 1px solid #E8E4DC; border-radius: 14px; transition: background 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #FDFBF7; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(240, 196, 68, 0.25); } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field with saffron focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: #0B0B0D; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #E8E4DC; border-radius: 14px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #525252; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #f0c444; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 243, 77, 0.15); } .ds-input:disabled { background: #FDFBF7; opacity: 0.6; }

components.css: .ds-product-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #E8E4DC; border-radius: 18px; box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(11, 11, 13, 0.03), 0 1px 2px rgba(11, 11, 13, 0.02); transition: border-color 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-product-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(11, 11, 13, 0.08), 0 4px 8px rgba(11, 11, 13, 0.04); } .ds-card-image { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1/1; object-fit: cover; } .ds-card-body { padding: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; flex: 1; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; color: #0B0B0D; margin: 0; } .ds-card-price { font-family: Geist Mono, ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #0B0B0D; margin: 0; } .ds-card-action { width: 36px; height: 36px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-top: auto; align-self: flex-end; background: #f0c444; color: #0B0B0D; border: none; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-card-action:hover { background: #e0b434; }

narrative.northStar: The friendly neighborhood store, lit by saffron.
narrative.overview: A warm, mobile-first grocery experience that borrows the familiarity of a local Chittagong kirana shop and translates it into a fast, trustworthy web interface. The visual system is intentionally simple: warm paper, deep-night text, and saffron as a rare, decisive accent. The design should never feel like a generic delivery app; every surface should signal a real store with real people behind it.
keyCharacteristics: Mobile-web PWA with native-feeling shell (bottom nav, sheets, floating action)
Warm neutral ground with rare saffron accent
Rounded, tactile surfaces with soft top-left-light shadows
Dark mode preserves accent warmth while flipping the ground to deep night
Bangla-aware font stack for localized moments
WhatsApp-forward support surfaced as a human safety net

rules.name: Saffron Rarity Rule
rules.body: Saffron occupies ≤10% of any given screen. Its scarcity is the signal.

rules.name: Warm Ground Rule
rules.body: Page backgrounds are warm paper in light mode and deep night in dark mode; avoid pure #FFFFFF page fills or #1A1A1A dark fills.

rules.name: Banner Shape Rule
rules.body: Hero, promo, and campaign banners are always landscape (16:9 or 21:9). Never place a 1:1 image inside a wide banner container.

rules.name: One Display Font Rule
rules.body: Bricolage is the only display face. Do not introduce a second display serif or decorative face.

rules.name: Bengali Fallback Rule
rules.body: Every type stack ends with Noto Sans Bengali so localized strings degrade gracefully without changing weight or rhythm.

rules.name: Mobile-Shell Rule
rules.body: Every screen must work as a single-column mobile viewport first; desktop layout is an upscale, not a redesign.

rules.name: 44px Touch Rule
rules.body: All interactive elements have a minimum touch target of 44px.

rules.name: Top-Left Light Rule
rules.body: Shadows assume a top-left light source, giving surfaces a consistent lift direction.

rules.name: Rest-Flat Rule
rules.body: At rest, surfaces sit nearly flat; elevation appears as a response to state (hover, focus, elevation) rather than as default decoration.

rules.name: Family Radius Rule
rules.body: Surfaces sharing a parent container use the same radius family (sm/md/lg/xl) so adjacent shapes harmonize.

dos: Do anchor every screen to warm paper (light) or deep night (dark).
Do use saffron as the single accent for primary actions and active states.
Do keep mobile touch targets at 44px or larger.
Do use wide landscape (16:9/21:9) imagery for hero and promo banners.
Do load the Bengali fallback in every text stack.
Do prefer soft shadows and tonal layering over harsh borders and dividers.
Do test dark mode for every new surface or component.
donts: Don't use #1A1A1A or #F5C518; these are superseded brand colors.
Don't place square 1:1 images in wide banner slots.
Don't scatter saffron across more than ~10% of a screen.
Don't introduce a second display typeface; Bricolage owns display moments.
Don't design desktop-first; the mobile shell is the canonical viewport.
Don't use decorative motion that delays the task; motion should be physical and fast (≈180ms base transition).
